comparison.objective: Stow three cases while keeping load off a fragile case; the candidate configures a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Packing, stacking, and rule-aware placement versus two-tool adjustment and locknut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: All cases lie correctly in two bays with no forbidden stack; candidate requires a locked target angle and repeated functional return.
comparison.reason: The tested packing and load-path planning ability is unrelated to preserving a mechanical setting during locking.
